products.title: Leg Attacks & Grappling Hacks by Dean Lister
products.body:
How To Surprise and Submit Your Opponents On the Mat. Even Younger, Stronger, Faster & Higher Ranked Beasts - With The Most Lethal & Least Understood Attack In Grappling: The Leglock.

  • Leglocks Are The Great Equalizer
  • Dean Lister's System Is Almost Like Cheating Because Your Adversaries Aren't Taught To Defend It
  • Leglocks have been called the great equalizer - it doesn't matter if you are big, strong, fast or flexible; all that you need to apply a successful leglock is the knowledge
  • Dean Lister holds submission victories by leg lock over some of the best bjj competitors including guys like Rodolfo Vieira
  • This is the original guide to leg locks

 

What Will You Learn?

Dean Lister's System Is Almost Like Cheating Because Your Adversaries Aren't Taught To Defend It. Leglocks have been called the great equalizer - it doesn't matter if you are big, strong, fast or flexible; all that you need to apply a successful leglock is the knowledge to get into the position and then watch your opponent scream and tap. A leglock is the type of position that scares the life out of people when you just mention it.

Even Mentioning This Position Makes People Lose Their Breath

Want to try a funny experiment to illustrate this point. Go into a new BJJ Gym and tell everyone there "I'm a white belt" or "I'm a blue belt" and no one will exactly be impressed but tag onto your self-assessment: "but I've trained a lot of leglocks" - the room will become so quiet that you will be able to hear a pin drop. The black belts will stop making eye contact so you don't ask them to spar.

Why?

Because everyone knows a higher belt who was humiliated and had to tap to a leglock. We all know the consequences. If you get your arm stretched in an armlock it is going to hurt and you might be out for a month. If you don't tap quick enough to a leglock it is going to paralyze you with pain and you might be out for a year.

Leglocks Are The Great Equalizer

One of the best leg lock teachers in the world is Esteemed BJJ and MMA coach John Danaher. His students: Eddie Cummings, Gary Tonon, and now Gordon Ryan are tearing up the EBI events with their slick leg attacks that no one can seemingly stop.

These aren't intimidating looking guys, they seem to be very nice and are very good at what they do and don't seem to be extraordinary athletes. Their success shows how leglocks can help every day people. Well John Danaher has admitted that his biggest influence for wanting to learn leglocks is the great Dean Lister.

 

You don't have to be young, strong, fast or flexible to do leglocks. All you need is the knowledge to perform them properly. There isn't no one more qualified than Dean Lister to show you his secret formula.

No One Has Done What Dean Lister Has Done With Leglocks - Or Even Close

 

Dean is the winningest American at the biggest No Gi Tournament in history: the ADCC – he has won 3 times and he has positively dominated with leglocks including a historic victory over the #1 grappler in the world at that time in 2011 – Rodolfo Viera – when he was 37, 40 lbs over his UFC competition weight and crippled with back and neck pain.

But when Dean unleashes his devastating leglock system, even the best guys in the world are powerless to defend it.

What will happen when you use it on the guys in your class?

DVD set is packed with over 40 Video Lessons with Attacks that will absolutely transform your game. It doesn't matter what belt your opponent is or how athletic they are. With Dean's leg locks you are good and they suck… it's over.

These techniques will help you more than you could have ever thought possible. The simple little details and tricks that Dean shows have never been showed before in film. They will give you a huge advantage in the gi or out of the gi. This will revolutionize your game.

products.body:
Take A Systematic Approach To Leg Locking With The Head Coach Of Energia Martial Arts Tum Energia Voorn’s Guide To Lower Body Submissions

  • Voorn has trained alongside some of the best leg lockers in the world including Dean Lister, Eddie Bravo, Lachlan Giles, and Craig Jones among many others
  • Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced BJJ player, the systems contained in this instructional will help you understand and elevate your leg lock game
  • Get an intro to all of the most important leg locking positions and the related techniques and submissions that go along with them, including entries and escape counters


Elevate And Improve Your Lower Body Attacking Skill Set With Leglocks Unlocked!

 

Check out a free sample:

 

 

What Will You Learn? 

 

With Leg Locks Unlocked, Tum Energia Voorn will guide you through the systematic steps of all of the most important leg locking positions and related techniques so that you can more deeply understand the utilities of each position and the strengths they offer. Voorn has trained alongside some of the biggest names in the leg locking game such as Dean Lister, Eddie Bravo, and Lachlan Giles and through his training has compiled a step by step approach to leg locks that anyone, regardless of rank, can use to elevate and improve their lower body attacking skillset!

 

Reaping Heel Hook

 

 

 

So, What’s In This Series

Beginners and advanced players alike will enjoy instruction on countless techniques to help you demolish the lower portions of the body. Explore drills, entries, control tactics, and loads of submissions, including inside and outside heel hooks, straight style locks, and much more, to help you become a more dangerous and well-rounded leg locking specialist!

 

Use This Entry From Butterfly Guard!

 

 


Leg locks can no longer be ignored! Whether you’re looking to break into the world of leg locks or searching for some new ways to spice up your current skillset, Voorn has you covered. He’ll start with the more easily digestible concepts and add more advanced themes as he progresses through this highly specialized instructional dedicated to understanding and improving your knowledge of this critical set of tools!
